_note: This page frames LIVE data from the mlops evidence hub. The frontend fetches `evidence.json` and fills the champion card, runs table, per-class F1 and confusion matrix; the copy here is the static framing around those charts. No numbers are hand-typed here.
title: Quality
subtitle: The model's report card — regenerated on every deploy
intro: This is how good the model is, straight from the system that built it — not a screenshot, not a number I typed in. Every panel below is drawn live from the platform's published record.

sections.title: The current champion
sections.body: The best model the pipeline has ever accepted — its accuracy, its version, and when it was crowned. This is read from the model registry, so it's always the model actually in charge.

sections.title: The quality gate
sections.body: Before any model ships, it has to clear an absolute accuracy floor and beat the reigning champion without regressing. The gate is the one part of the pipeline allowed to say no.

callout.label: blocked
callout.text: The gate saying no, on the record — a challenger regressed and the deploy never ran. This is the gate working, and you can open the CI run that proves it.

sections.title: Every registered run
sections.body: The registry is the source of truth: CI retrains on every change that can affect the model, and each run is recorded here with the number it scored — the ones that shipped and the ones that didn't.

sections.title: Per-class F1
sections.caption: 15 doodle classes · 1,000 test doodles each
sections.body: How reliably the model recognises each kind of drawing. Dogs are hard — they quietly collect the cat-shaped mistakes — while geometric shapes like stars and clocks are nearly perfect. Hover a class for its precision and recall.

sections.title: Where it gets confused
sections.caption: true class (down) → predicted class (across)
sections.body: A grid of what gets mistaken for what. The bright diagonal is everything the model got right; the off-diagonal smudges are the honest mistakes — and they cluster exactly where a person squinting at a tiny doodle would slip too.

footer: Everything on this page renders from the platform's published contracts — no screenshots, no hand-typed numbers.
